found + fixed two real traps by measuring, not assuming: (1) framework.css base layer sets table { display: block }, so table-layout: fixed on the <table> element does nothing until table-equal also restates display: table; (2) styles.css's .md td:first-child { white-space: nowrap } (a deliberate rule for docs tables whose first column is a short keyword) fought this table's long first-column prose, so table-equal also resets white-space: normal on its own td/th. Final rule is two small declarations, not one.

verified headless (private server :8095, Playwright via the global install): th widths equal within <0.1% at 400 (187.67/187.67), 1280 (245.89/245.91) and 3440 (526.41/526.41); zero overflowing cells, zero horizontal doc overflow, zero console errors at all three widths. At 400 the table stays readable - narrow (188px) columns wrap to more lines but nothing clips; no long unbroken token in this table's real content, so no word-break question came up. Screenshot: table-3440.png.

finding, not fixed (outside fences - mvp/page.js's own top comment says 'two markdown tables, each .ac("wide")' but only one md() call renders an actual table; the steps() block has no table. Pre-existing drift, left as found per the one-.ac()-line fence.

assign.outcome: **`table-equal` lands** — a framework utility that splits a table's columns evenly (`table-layout: fixed; width: 100%`, plus `display: table` to undo framework.css's own `table { display: block }`, plus `white-space: normal` on its own td/th to undo `styles.css`'s docs-table nowrap rule) and reaches the table through whatever wrapper `md()` gives it — the wrapper itself when the whole block is one table, a descendant otherwise. Wired to the [MVP page](/imagine/platform/mvp/)'s "Where the verdicts disagree" table (`.ac("wide table-equal")`). Verified headless, private server: column `th` widths equal within 0.1% at 400/1280/3440, zero overflowing cells, zero console errors. At 400 it stays readable — narrower, more wrapped lines, nothing clips; this table has no long unbroken token so the word-break question never came up. Rule: `public/framework/framework.css` (`@layer util`, beside `.measure`). New prefix `table-` registered in `public/framework/styles/css-scopes.txt` (the framework block is closed to new bare words). Doc line: `public/framework/core/Page/doc/columns.md`, beside the existing `.md`+`wide` sentence.
